side_deck._note: timber deck over the paved patio at the end of the side path: from where the planted bed stops (the chimney line) to the lounge's north wall, house wall to the fence; top 100 above the pavers, boards running along the path

tree._note: lemon tree in the rear bed, near but not in the south-west corner: trunk about 0.7 m in from the west fence and 0.55 m out from the rear fence, under the second lattice panel; about 2.7 m tall and 2.6 m across, canopy leaning east into the yard and pruned flat against both fences (listing photo facing south; close-up photo 'south east neighbour.MP'). The bed bulges out round it (the real brick edge curves out there); 'bed' is that bump-out's corner, clear of the outdoor-dining chairs

hot_water._note: Rinnai B26 continuous-flow, outside west wall

kitchen_south_wall._note: bath door, wall, pantry door in one flush line; back door set back in the rear wall to the west

rug._note: 2500 x 4000 low-pile rug (custom size) in oatmeal and taupe with a fine streaky weave and a bound edge. All legs on: the whole sofa (footprint x 3.68-5.82, y 20.50-24.11) and the coffee table sit on it, 200-300 past the sofa's open ends (rule: at least 150-200 beyond the sofa each side, the full chaise on), ~60-190 past its backs (glass wall, sliders). Leaves 650 of floor in front of the walnut unit and ~150-470 to the walls. A stock 3000 x 4000 would come within 150 of the walnut unit; 2400 x 3400 stops short of the chaise and the curve. Low pile (12 mm): clears the side door's swing at its north edge
